name: Clarissa
title: Canopus Rangers
description: A girl who once worked as a hunter in the Canopus Mountains. She was born with superhuman eyesight. Though she is energetic and loves pranks, she avoids getting too close to anyone.
introduction:
A girl from the Aruk tribe living in the Canopus Mountains.
The Aruk tribe gains superhuman abilities through their special bloodline, and Clarissa has inherited her father's superhuman eyesight.

Following her tribe's long-standing tradition of protecting the Canopus Mountains, she joined the Rangers and rose quickly to a senior position thanks to her remarkable skill, but her overly free-spirited nature has caused some friction with the leader of the Rangers.

Playful and outgoing, Clarissa is capable of quickly befriending anyone, yet at times she can be seen staring into the distance with a hardened expression.
Before joining the Rangers, she learned to hunt from her father and has strong pride as a hunter.
